findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe struct.unpack operations
 * @description Using struct.unpack with untrusted input can lead to buffer overflows
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-struct-unpack
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-119
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("struct").getMember("unpack").getACall()
select call, "Potential unsafe struct.unpack operation with untrusted data that could cause buffer overflow."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe struct.unpack operations that could lead to buffer overflows when parsing untrusted timezone files

message.text: Potential unsafe struct.unpack operation with untrusted data that could cause buffer overflow.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Race condition in file operations (TOCTOU)
 * @description Time-of-check-time-of-use race conditions in file operations
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/race-condition-file
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode checkCall, DataFlow::CallCfgNode useCall
where
  // Check operations
  (
    checkCall = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["path", "path!"]).getMember(["exists", "isfile", "isdir", "islink"]).getACall() or
    checkCall = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["access"]).getACall()
  )
  and
  // Use operations (file opens)
  (
    useCall = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
    useCall = API::moduleImport("io").getMember(["open", "FileIO"]).getACall()
  )
  and
  // Same file argument (simplified check)
  checkCall.getArg(0).toString() = useCall.getArg(0).toString()
select useCall, "Potential TOCTOU race condition: file checked then used without proper synchronization"
findings.hypothesis: Race conditions in file operations (TOCTOU vulnerabilities)

message.text: Potential TOCTOU race condition: file checked then used without proper synchronization
